A monotone force ramp can still resonate
Duration and monotonicity do not establish the uniform-ramp bound. Take F(t)=2500*(1-t/.5)+50*sin(2*pi*10*t)N for0<=t<=.5s, k2MN/m and a10Hz mode (effective mass506.6059kg). The largest derivative is -1858.407N/s, so the applied force remains monotone decreasing. Yet its resonant perturbation leaves
A=epsilon*omega*T/(2*k)=.392699mm,
whereas the uniform-ramp untuned envelope is .0795775mm. The phasor integral of Fdot was independently evaluated by midpoint quadrature and matches this analytic amplitude. A small bounded force variation or a catalog actuation time does not certify energy-controlled release.

Actual metering needs a constrained waveform, derivative/variation or dissipation contract and observable error. A retained tool can measure and correct a reaction only within real rate, travel, force, bias and stiffness limits. Mode frequency changes, coulomb friction, contact impacts, backlash, controller delay and power loss must enter the physical design. The scalar oscillator is not a complete holder or all-time nonlinear certificate.

title: Do not transfer a uniform-ramp bound from duration and monotonicity
